ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) pixels to 60% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white patch on the distal half of the left-most lobe; dense, high-frequency black-and-white mottling (salt-and-pepper effect) concentrated in the central and proximal regions of the fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged serrations with variable pixel amplitude (2-8 pixels) along the trailing boundary of the left-most lobe, exhibiting prominent peaks near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge of the left-most lobe follows a slightly concave trajectory from the distal tip toward the obscured center, while the leading edge is a smooth convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white rings (barnacle scars) detected on the dark-pigmented surface of the right-most lobe and central fluke region near the water line.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) cutting through the dark-pigmented field on the central-left fluke area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or loss of pigment/tissue at the extreme distal tip of the left-most lobe; numerous circular barnacle attachment scars.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique dense speckled pattern transitioning between the solid white distal patch and the solid black proximal base of the left lobe.
